newsitem.title: UK: Croatia sees GDP up about 6 pct/yr in medium term.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sees GDP up about 6 pct/yr in medium term.

text.p: The Croatian economy will grow at around six percent a year in the medium term, a senior finance ministry official said on Monday.

Ivan Mijatovic, a departmental head, told the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development that gross domestic product grew some six percent last year after 5.7 percent in 1995.
"We are going to be able to maintain this growth in the short and medium term," he said.

Leading commercial bank Zagrebacka Banka said on Monday it expected GDP growth of 4.9 percent in 1997, revising downwards its forecast from an earlier 5.5 percent after a decline in the fourth quarter of last year.
Mijatovic also said the former Yugoslav republic's 1997 fiscal deficit would be 2.63 percent of GDP after a 0.14 percent deficit last year.
